inputMapping.description: RFC 0022 §B. When `true`, host honors the `inputMapping` field on `core.subWorkflow` configs — seeding the child workflow's initial variable bag from `parentVariables[parentKey]` projections, overriding any matching `variables[].defaultValue` declaration on the child. When `false` or absent, hosts MUST refuse workflows that carry a non-empty `inputMapping` at registration with `validation_error` + `details.requiredCapability: 'subWorkflow.inputMapping'`. Silent ignore is NOT conformant.
